correctness.rationale: The finite-window conclusions are supported by the archived census. I independently parsed all 6,084 rows of artifacts/T5000.csv from GitHub in seven disjoint line ranges. The d-set equals exactly the squarefree nonzero integers with |d|<=5000; there are no missing or extra d. Summing sel_size gives 12,136, hence M=12136/6084=3034/1521≈1.9947403 and |M-3|≈1.00526>0.15. The Selmer-dimension histogram is {0:2106,1:3011,2:932,3:35}; rank-bound pairs are (0,0):2549, (1,1):3037, (2,2):313, (3,3):9, (0,2):176; max r_lo=max r_hi=3; the nine r_lo=3 twists are exactly {-4399,-1799,-1007,-206,1393,1766,2362,2878,4582}. Every row satisfies sel_size=2^sel_dim, sel_dim=r_hi+T_dim+s_sha, and the stated parity identity. PARI/GP 2.15.4 documentation confirms ellrank computes the exact 2-Selmer rank C and uses r2=C-T-s, so the table relation used to recover sel_dim is consistent with the documented algorithm. I did not rerun PARI itself, so the underlying descent values still inherit trust in the archived PARI computation.

originality.rationale: The exact 11a1 height-5000 vector, moment 3034/1521, histogram, and nine rank-3 twists were not found in targeted searches using 11a1/X0(11), the exact fraction, and witness values. Poonen–Rains and related work provide distributional heuristics/general theory, not this finite curve-specific table. The record is original as a reproducible finite dataset and target decision, not as a new Selmer-distribution theorem.

scientific_value.rationale: A complete finite census on the canonical conductor-11 curve is a reusable arithmetic-statistics benchmark. It decisively answers the pre-registered finite-window disjunction, records exact Selmer/rank-bound distributions, and supplies a consistency-certified dataset for later comparisons. The value is empirical/computational and should not be inflated into an asymptotic statement; within that scope it is substantial enough to retain.

evidence: All 6,084 archived T5000.csv rows were independently reparsed from GitHub and recomputed for counts, moment, rank-bound extrema, parity and coherence.
Targeted web searches found no earlier publication of the exact 11a1 dataset or moment fraction.
Repository research files were read at the assigned tree; no GitHub writes were made.
limitations: The PARI/GP 2.15.4 descent was not rerun in this audit; underlying Selmer/rank-bound entries inherit trust in PARI and the archived generation run.
The 176 (0,2) rows do not have exact Mordell–Weil rank determined by the table, although this does not affect max r_hi=3 or the finite target decision.
No asymptotic conclusion about Poonen–Rains follows from the height-5000 mean.
